$comment: Where each fixture came from. Nothing here is a response to a job this pack ran: no task was submitted and no file was uploaded while the pack was written, and no fixture contains an API key.

catalogue.json.source: GET https://api.wavespeed.ai/api/v3/models with the owner's key on 2026-10-02 (1079 models, 1.9 MB); the ten entries of models.json, kept exactly as returned

prices.json.source: POST https://api.wavespeed.ai/api/v3/model/price on 2026-10-02, one per request the tests quote, recorded by running the pack's own quote() through a forwarding fetch; `request` is exactly what the pack sent, `response` exactly what WaveSpeed answered. Every amount equals the model's documented price table.

errors.json.source: badKey: GET /api/v3/models with a made-up key; unknownModel and badEnum: POST /api/v3/model/price; unknownTask: GET /api/v3/predictions/<made-up id>/result. All on 2026-10-02; none can create or charge a task.

results-completed.json.source: the `initialExampleResult` of each model's page https://wavespeed.ai/models/<modelId> (a real completed run WaveSpeed displays), with `outputs` replaced by the page's `cover_url` — the output file of that run (the page stores the list out-of-line). Keyed by model id.

tasks.json.source: statuses from https://wavespeed.ai/docs/get-result and https://wavespeed.ai/docs/what-are-predictions; the failed task's `code`/`error` from https://wavespeed.ai/docs/error-codes (1402 Media Access Failed). No failed, timed-out, cancelled or deleted task was available to record.

upload-ticket.json.source: https://wavespeed.ai/docs/upload-files-api, 'Response' (hosts replaced by reserved example hosts). Not recorded live: creating a ticket is not read-only.
